newsitem.title: CHINA: China Feb industrial taxes up 16.5 pct yr-on-yr.
newsitem.headline: China Feb industrial taxes up 16.5 pct yr-on-yr.

text.p: China collected 40.521 billion yuan ($4.88 billion) in industrial and commercial taxes in February, up 16.5 percent from the same period of 1996, the China Taxation News said on Monday.
Collection of value-added tax and consumption taxes accounted for more than half of the increase in revenues, rising 3.265 billion yuan, or 16.3 percent year-on-year, it said.
Collection of business taxes rose 11.2 percent, while collection of personal income taxes soared 38.9 percent year-on-year, the newspaper said but gave no figures.
In the first two months, China's collection of industrial and commercial taxes rose 14.7 percent from the same period last year, accounting for 14 percent of the annual target, it said.

But tax arrears had rebounded despite the rise in total tax revenue, it said. Total tax arrears by enterprises hit 35.641 billion yuan at the end of February, up by 8.1 billion yuan from the beginning of the year.
